source.title: Fantasy football insurance RB rankings: Which backups are must-drafts?
source.author: Eric Moody
source.summary: Ranks backup running backs by stand-alone usability and the upside they would gain if the starter missed time.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Moody ranks Gainwell first: usable in deeper leagues now and an RB1 candidate if Bucky Irving misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Moody ranks Gainwell first: usable in deeper leagues now and an RB1 candidate if Bucky Irving misses time.
risks: Role, health, team context, and draft price can change before the season.
